title: Multi-Observable RH Convergence Measurement

scope.observable_c: Hilbert-Pólya proxy: det of Jacobi matrix A (prime-index differences)

bipartition: balanced (n//2 vs n - n//2) on prime-state |P_N>
prime_state_construction: Grover-like over primes <= N, oracle U_f|p>|0> = |p>|is_prime(p)>
mocs_definition: MOCS = count of RH-consistent observables in {a, b, c}
falsifiable_statement: H_MOCS: MOCS >= 2 after measurement on N in [7, 1023]
tests: tests/test_pt_rh_multi_observable.py (validates each observable on small N)
